title: TermAl mediates turns but reports nothing about them to Engram
outcome: A turn TermAl mediates leaves host-observed facts in the store: the session is bound to the work it executes, and the checkpoint carries the turn's execution observations and, where the host ran a check, verification and environment evidence.
acceptance: a TermAl-mediated turn on claimed work records at least one execution observation on that run, with source_changed set when the turn changed source
a check the host ran is recorded as typed verification evidence with its environment, so the builtin source-change rule and a bound acceptance criterion can be satisfied under TermAl
the control session TermAl binds for an agent that holds a claim carries that claim's exact work binding

completion.summary: TermAl (build acd7740) reports mediated turns to Engram: turn observations with a content-v1 source revision, a host-observed test recorded as passed verification with environment evidence, and the control session carrying the held claim's binding; shown live on 2026-09-27 with `cargo test --test source_file_size` under this claim. Known gaps tracked by TermAl, outside these criteria: turns started by a background-task notice are not mediated (tm-w5td), an indeterminate check gives no reason (tm-xtyb), the watcher's false source_changed (tm-97wp, fixed in 0d54fd1, not yet running), and the measured tree is the session's workdir until phase 2.
